scripts.i18n:pot: npm run cli -- wp i18n make-pot /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/tscf /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/tscf/languages/tscf.pot --slug=tscf --domain=tscf --exclude=tests,node_modules,vendor,assets/lib,assets/js/dist --allow-root
